item.title: DeLand High students join nationwide walkout over ICE
item.description: Chanting and carrying signs, DeLand High School students walked out of class Friday and marched through Downtown, joining a nationwide protest opposing immigration enforcement policies. The student-led demonstration took place during the school day and ended with a gathering at the intersection of New York Avenue and Woodland Boulevard.
